card.line: Babylon was a great city on the Euphrates and the capital of Nebuchadnezzar's empire, where many people of Judah were taken into exile.

moments.title: A Letter to the Exiles
moments.text: Jeremiah's letter was addressed to the exiles Nebuchadnezzar had carried to Babylon. It told them that when Babylon's seventy years were complete, the LORD would restore them to their home.

moments.title: Daniel Pleads for the Wise Men
moments.text: The king was so angry that he ordered all the wise men of Babylon destroyed. Daniel answered with tact, asked his friends to plead for God's mercy, and then asked Arioch not to execute the wise men.

moments.title: The Golden Statue Accusation
moments.text: Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden statue and commanded everyone to worship it. Some astrologers then accused Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego of refusing to serve his gods or worship the statue.
